svg.aria-label: Blueprint scene split by a thin vertical line. Left: a small worried human beside a line of four identical robots shrinking toward a vanishing point, captioned "1,000,000 robots." Right: a blue milk carton covered in seven white safety labels stands next to a single robot wearing one blank yellow label. Top banner reads "Fewer rules than milk."
